Current Openings

Business Systems Developer

Business Systems Developer
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the Role

As a Salesforce Developer on our Business Systems team, you'll own solutions end to end — from requirements and architecture through build, deployment, and support — partnering directly with GTM business owners and other systems owners. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role across our go-to-market systems. AI-assisted development is part of how we work.

What You'll Do
Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions — Apex, LWC, Flows, etc.
Diagnose and resolve complex platform issues — async/bulk data processing, integrations, etc.
Determine the right solution — declarative, programmatic, an AI application, or outside the platform
Build applied-AI solutions when they fit — e.g., an assistant or agent in place of a traditional form or page
Contribute to adjacent systems and codebases — not your primary focus, but a regular part of the role
Use AI tooling to move faster — development, codebase ramp-up, etc.
Own the full lifecycle, from architecture through support
Translate business requirements into well-architected technical solutions
Required
Deep, platform-level Salesforce expertise and sound engineering patterns
3+ years hands-on Salesforce development: Apex, SOQL, LWC, Flows
Full-stack development fundamentals; working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and how web frameworks generalize beyond Salesforce
Git and CI/CD
Proficiency with AI-assisted development
Applied-AI solutioning — recognizing when an AI application is the right answer, and designing for it
Clear, precise communication and quick, structured thinking
Preferred
Domain experience in Sales or Marketing
React / TypeScript / Next.js, FastAPI / Python, Tailwind; general AI plumbing
Working knowledge of web infrastructure and security
Fluency with AI-native development workflows — MCP servers, agentic tooling, and structured prompting
Familiarity with a GTM stack: Outreach, CPQ, billing concepts
Salesforce Platform Developer I / II

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture.  For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.
